method: Seed3 STM32H750 at 480 MHz, Beads clocks, 2 flash wait states; gap-study harness ABC (codec DMA, 1 kHz SysTick Ui::Poll, main loop); 16,000 warm-up + 4,096 timed blocks, two runs; cost = change of the engine's worst measured callback median (GainControl + attack detector + DSP), in points of a 4 kHz block (1 point = 1,200 cycles), times the Seed3-to-module factor (synth 1.000, granular 1.016); UI features: Ui::Poll maximum (a SysTick tick preempts the callback).

page_note: Each feature's cpu object has the page's fields (off, fixed, adjustable) plus engines.synth and engines.granular. The top-level fields are the larger of the two engines, which over-counts on the synth where engines differ: Reverb character (Clouds-style is already in the synth baseline: synth 0, granular +1.2) and Limiter fast release. Read engines[engine] per engine to avoid that. Reference: synth = the 87.2% baseline configuration (Clouds-style, width 255, Raag Shri); granular = release defaults (stock reverb, no scale, width and diffusion off), the 83.0% fixture. fixed[v] = that value always on; adjustable[v] = worst reachable value (all values can be chosen at run time); off = stock value. Pitch scale values not measured (Fifths, Minor, pentatonics, Pelog, Bhairav) take the largest measured scale cost. Points are of a 4 kHz block (1 point = 1,200 cycles at 480 MHz). Costs are changes of the engine's worst measured callback median; features that only touch lighter scenarios (delay mode, frozen feedback, TIME scan) cost 0 against the engine's worst case; their raw scenario deltas are in note.
